## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      1 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 4 сент. 2026 г. - 4 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Anthony C_, 4 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "It does not synch sometimes to health connect it did not record my activity today. I even downloaded health sync and paid for the one time purchase subscription. still not synching. Even in Strava it sometimes does not sync, you have manually upload your activity which is a hassle. Been using Xiaomi Watch 5 during activity in the middle of the run it glitched and you have to start over again. Happened twice now in one month of use. I'm beginning to regret buying a Xiaomi watch too many issues."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      2 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 17 июл. 2026 г. - 5 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Sayan B_, 5 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "Keeps logging me out and disconnecting from me watch without any notifications. Recently started getting this issue where it's disconnecting from my watch, keeps crashing and also disables the biometric authentication on other apps. Been using this app for 7 years, something recently just broke all functionality."
            2. _Anthony C_, 4 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "It does not synch sometimes to health connect it did not record my activity today. I even downloaded health sync and paid for the one time purchase subscription. still not synching. Even in Strava it sometimes does not sync, you have manually upload your activity which is a hassle. Been using Xiaomi Watch 5 during activity in the middle of the run it glitched and you have to start over again. Happened twice now in one month of use. I'm beginning to regret buying a Xiaomi watch too many issues."
            3. _Ariel Brnssn_, 2 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Tiene algunos bug la app. No deja poner fotos en las caratulas"
